text: Psalm 133 A Song of Ascents. Of David. Behold, how good and how pleasant it is for brothers to dwell together in unity!
It is like precious oil upon the head, that runs down on the beard— even Aaron’s beard— and going down to the collar of his garments;
as the dew of Hermon, that descends upon the mountains of Zion, for there the Lord has commanded the blessing, even life forever.
